title: f83r P5 complete exploratory rota instructions: persistent singers, cue ownership and opposed accompaniment pauses
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED. Complete new 62-group descendant of RAW373: all six old whole-word hypotheses retained, 47 new whole-form guesses fill 48 old unknown positions, and 14 declared productions give a whole instruction program. Successive entries use each immediate predecessor while both accompaniment clocks persist. All source rhythm alternatives remain; C2 gives 23-unit pes periods against 12-unit entries. This is an untested, freely fitted working interpretation, not a translation or repair of GDT970.

decision_note.unknown_after_primary_review: RAW373 explicitly leaves 48 of 62 positions unknown. RAW364 and RAW440 supply source/concurrency ideas without a complete target grammar. The owned historical packet already computes conditional source performances, while GDT970 tests a different literal event-code consequence. The bounded primary review found no execution of a full RAW373 target reading; this is not an absolute claim about every unsearched file.
decision_note.changed_input: One newly written complete target interpretation, with all guesses and productions exposed. No new manuscript/source material, no revised old code or claim of a new historical music law.
decision_note.pass_changes: Retain one internally coherent full projected-paragraph music reading, with its exact source and transcription ambiguities. It may become a concrete rival to other readings; no music identification or probability advantage follows.
decision_note.fail_changes: Reject the fixed new descendant on its stated grammar, participant or temporal contract. Preserve RAW373 unknowns and GDT970 unchanged. Do not repair meanings, clauses, references or duration choices after seeing a failure.
decision_note.smallest_test: Parse every projected group using this exact lexical/production table; compile all fourteen declarations to a typed participant/trigger/rest graph before performance execution. Check reference resolution and source-rule coverage, then independently execute the 2/3/4-rota-singer cases under each of the four already owned source duration branches, including initialization and a full common-period window. Compare full voice-indexed traces and all rules, not selected notes. Report the two unresolved diplomatic bindings separately.

whole_paragraph_clauses.effect: Introduce ordered pair (U,L); assign(U,P1), assign(L,P2); common onset; repeat each assigned part while need continues. Together is onset equality, not equality of notes.

whole_paragraph_clauses.reading: Every following singer pauses only at the written pauses.
The upper accompaniment pauses at its end; the lower one pauses internally.

whole_paragraph_clauses.effect: OTHER_MEMBER resolves L from C05. Sing P2, retain its internal rest, forbid an extra end rest, repeat P2 with no added end delay.

whole_paragraph_clauses.reading: For every rota singer, a written pause lasts one long note.
whole_paragraph_clauses.effect: For each r in R and each written rest of M: duration=one source longa. Numeric duration is supplied separately by each retained C0-C3 source branch. This clause does not silently extend the prose rule to pes.

whole_paragraph_clauses.effect: Apply R02 lower-count qualification to R, not FOLLOWERS alone and not R+PES. Enumerate N=2,3,4 as the existing source examples, not an asserted exhaustive maximum.

grammar_contract.mode: Read the whole paragraph as declarations defining one performance specification. Written order is not global performance chronology. Compile C14 exception before evaluating any startup or entry guard.
grammar_contract.terminals: Exact projected whole forms and spaces are terminals. No character deletion, components, phonetics, new stem rule, cross-word atom or spelling equivalence.
grammar_contract.productions: Exactly the fourteen typed terminal-tag sequences in whole_paragraph_clauses, in the stated fourteen line positions. Each admits precisely the argument/effect mapping written there; there is no free clause deletion, inert filler, alternative chunking or learned permutation.
grammar_contract.production_freedom: Fourteen largely one-off productions are fitted to this exposed paragraph. They are not an independently learned grammar or evidence for these readings. This deliberate exploratory freedom must remain visible.
grammar_contract.coordination_ellipsis: Only C05 inherits PAUSE into its second coordinated member. Only C08 reuses the explicitly referenced prior cue rule with new participant arguments. No other missing predicates may be inserted.
reference_conventions: FOLLOWER is a role predicate: EACH/ALL quantify it; C07 selects its first member; C11 constrains the encompassing rota group. Repetition does not create new singers.
ONE in C06 and LEADER in C07/C14 resolve the same R0.
OTHER_MEMBER in C09 resolves lower pes L from the explicitly ordered pair in C05.
THAT in C12 resolves the single cross-owned cue X named in C07. PREDECESSOR/NEXT use C07-C08 trigger edges.
EXCEPT in C14 scopes only over C13; it does not erase C04/C09 pause restrictions.
grammar_contract.roundtrip_limit: Retain each terminal and clause provenance so a parser can reconstruct the projected 62-group input exactly. A roundtrip alone is not a semantic test and does not settle the two diplomatic forms.

semantic_contract.participants: Choose one of the already source-permitted cases N=2,3,4. Distinct R0..R(N-1) perform M; distinct U,L perform P1,P2. R0 is leader; Ri, i>0 are followers. A role, a physical singer, a part, and a particular event occurrence are distinct records.

externally_guessed_content_bindings.ROTA/M: The complete already owned 79-event main sequence (73 notes and six rests), not a freshly invented motif.
externally_guessed_content_bindings.CROSS_CUE/X: First onset of MN010 after X01, not MN009 or arbitrary delay.

semantic_contract.binding_limit: These four links to the Harley source are additional unconfirmed referent assumptions. No Voynich score, cross, note or performer owner has been identified. This is hypothetical prose referring to defined musical material, not a claim that 62 words losslessly encode 97 notes/rests or that the manuscript copies Harley.

fixed_operators.SING: Execute successive note/rest events of the performer's own assigned part on that performer's local clock. Same operator for C06 leader and C09 lower pes; the argument-owned part changes the trace.
fixed_operators.REPEAT: After the complete current part, restart that part from its beginning on the same voice clock, with no added delay or new singer. Same operator for following rota singers in C02 and the two pes in C03.
fixed_operators.TOGETHER: Assert onset equality for the subject set; preserve all individual part identities and local clock trajectories.
fixed_operators.ENTER: Single inactive-to-active transition of a rota singer at its first prescribed onset. A later part repeat is not a second ENTER.
fixed_operators.WHEN: Create an event dependency using a resolved owner and cue, not a free equal-time spacing or textual adjacency relation.
fixed_operators.PAUSE: A rest is a duration-carrying event with its written owner/location. Internal versus terminal is topological, not equal-half duration.
fixed_operators.NO_END_PAUSE: Forbid an added terminal rest on P2; do not delete P2's already written internal rest.

semantic_contract.phase_persistence: An ENTER on any Ri updates only that singer's active flag/start time. It cannot reset U or L, change their parts, or restart their cycles. Motif repetitions preserve participant identity.
semantic_contract.leader_repeat_assumption: The main part is interpreted as a cyclic rota for every selected rota performer, including R0. The owned source packet calls this the ordinary rota reading. It is an explicit source interpretation, not a separately identified target REPEAT word for the leader.
semantic_contract.written_pause_scope: C04 restricts follower rest positions; C10 assigns source longa duration to all rota written rests. The assigned M supplies the same written pauses for R0. Extending numeric longa realization to pes is only the old source-branch assumption, not a new conclusion from C10.
semantic_contract.duration_policy: Use the four exact documentary_duration_branches in ROTA_SOURCE_EVENTS.json separately. Keep all their qualifications, C2 prose/score disagreement and C3 constructed attribution sensitivity. No branch optimization, Cartesian-product expansion or certified historical rhythm claim.
semantic_contract.need_and_window: The source fixes no finite stop or repeat count. For a bounded diagnostic hold the common need flag true through [0, last_entry + lcm(M_period,P1_period,P2_period)). This is an observation window, not a source-prescribed performance ending. Include complete event pairs crossing the boundary with clipping separately labeled; compare startup and at least one common period after all entries.
semantic_contract.complete_source_scope: The hypothetical account covers every operative rule R01-R07 plus explicit consequences about early entry and leader exception. It does not translate either lyric, syllable alignment, every note name, tempo, absolute pitch, or a finite stopping command.
